tldr: Saturn in the 2nd house: structure becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Saturn in the 2nd house, this part of you matures through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Saturn describes structure, limits, discipline, time, responsibility, fear, and earned authority. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Saturn can become commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to build something durable.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed.
gift: commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to build something durable expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
